correctness.rationale: Exact beta/gamma moments diagonalize the radial Toeplitz symbol; a gamma recurrence gives the one-step weighted commutator with coefficient a_n=tau n^{-1}|1+b e^{-i tau log n}|+O(n^{-2}). The sufficient bound b<1/(1+tau) ensures a unique, uniformly transverse threshold root H(theta). Sorting errors can alter only O(1) lattice indices uniformly in the log phase; all smaller/greater indices are controlled by the fixed amplitude envelope. Harmonic summation and a Ky Fan sandwich convert the unsorted periodic n^{-1} sequence to the sorted singular logarithmic average; elliptic substitution gives the stated Dixmier residue.
